findings.evidence: lens (amendment 8.10): git status lists only the design doc, docs/rounds.jsonl and gate.toml as modified in the post; results.json, build_analysis.py, household.py, make_charts.py, seki.py and the predictions file are clean against HEAD 07b9a9e; results.json has no L7 key; gate.toml lost one [claims] line, not a test rule.
